query:
insert into
                attributes (entry_id, name, nonce, encrypted_value, hashed_value, created_at, updated_at)
                values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, datetime('now'), datetime('now'))
                on conflict(entry_id, name) do update set
                  nonce = $3
                , encrypted_value = $4
                , hashed_value = $5
                , updated_at = datetime('now')
                returning id
